short.q: Explain two reasons why global energy demand is increasing.
short.model: Population growth means more people need energy; and increased wealth means more cars, appliances and industry, especially in emerging countries.

short.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of nuclear power.
short.model: Advantage: no CO₂ is emitted when generating, so less climate change. Disadvantage: radioactive waste remains dangerous for thousands of years.

short.q: Explain why a balanced energy mix improves energy security.
short.model: A country that uses several sources is not reliant on one fuel or supplier, so supply continues if one source becomes expensive or runs out.
points: supply continues if a source fails

short.q: Explain two ways of managing energy sustainably in industry or transport.
short.model: Efficiency: more efficient machines or electric vehicles use less energy for the same output. Conservation: car-sharing and public transport reduce energy used.

short.q: Describe how a named country has changed its energy mix.
short.model: The UK reduced coal use to almost zero by 2024 and increased gas and offshore wind, to cut CO₂ emissions.
points: change described with data or detail
